description: A side-view shopping cart has an open trapezoidal basket tapering toward its flat bottom. The right side extends upward as a slanted handle, and two separate circular wheels sit below the basket.

A side-view shopping cart has a tapered basket with rounded lower corners and a tall slanted handle at the right. A short curved support descends toward the right wheel, with two circular wheels beneath the basket.
A side-view shopping cart has a wide trapezoidal basket and a slanted right-side handle extending above and below its edge. Two small filled wheel dots sit separately beneath the basket.

A side-view shopping cart has a handle projecting left from a slanted upright and a basket with a rounded lower-right corner. The upright curls beneath the basket, above two small separate wheel dots.
A side-view shopping cart has a shallow trapezoidal basket narrowing toward the bottom and a slanted handle along its right side. Two small filled wheel dots sit below the open basket.
A diagonal slash rises from lower left to upper right between two open circles. One circle sits at the upper left and the other at the lower right, forming a balanced percent symbol.
A diagonal slash rises from lower left to upper right between two open circles. One circle sits at the upper left and the other at the lower right, forming a balanced percent symbol.
A handbag has a broad rounded base, tapering sides, and a single arched handle above the top edge. A curved front flap spans the body and meets a small oval clasp in the centre.
A front-facing cash register has a sloping keypad above a broad rectangular drawer. A short receipt protrudes from the upper left, while a small display stands on a post at the upper right.
A compact printer has a low rounded front panel with a small central indicator and a raised rear housing. A tall receipt projects upward, showing two horizontal text lines and a zigzag torn edge.
A side-view mechanical register has a tall rounded rear column and a curved sloping front with projecting keys. Two circular joints connected by a diagonal crank sit above its broad rectangular base.
A tall receipt has square upper corners and a zigzag torn lower edge. Three rows of long item lines align with short price marks at the right, followed by a shorter line below.
A tall receipt has rounded upper corners and a zigzag torn lower edge. Three rows of long item lines align with short price marks at the right, followed by a shorter line below.
A front-facing upper-body figure has a circular featureless head above rounded shoulders. An apron covers the torso, with two shoulder straps and a wide squared neckline between them.
A front-facing oval face has a smooth cap of hair with an off-centre pointed parting. Two short eye marks and a small curved smile sit within the otherwise open face.
A barista wearing a brimmed cap and an apron stands behind a counter. A cash register with a small raised display sits to the left, beside the figure’s shoulder and torso.
A front-facing man stands behind a wide counter with rounded upper corners. A curved hairline crosses his circular head, while a pointed necktie hangs between the rounded shoulders of his shirt.
A front-facing woman stands behind a wide counter with rounded upper corners. Her parted hair frames the face and extends beside the neck, above a shirt with a pointed V-shaped neckline.
A small retail stall has a striped awning with four rounded scallops supported by two upright posts. A wide tapered counter panel beneath the opening bears the uppercase word SALE.

A striped canopy with four rounded scallops sits above the uppercase word SALE. A shallow curved bottom border turns upward at both ends beneath the lettering, suggesting the lower edge of a storefront.
A wide rounded rectangular sign hangs from a triangular cord attached near its upper corners. A smaller rectangular inset border frames the blank centre of the signboard.
A wide rounded signboard hangs from a horizontal overhead bar by two short vertical supports. The uppercase word SHOP spans the centre of the board, with open space around the lettering.
A small front-facing shop has a broad awning with four rounded scallops above a rectangular facade. A short upright seam rises from the bottom centre, dividing the lower portion of the storefront.
A small front-facing shop has a rectangular facade beneath a broad awning with sloping sides and four rounded scallops. The entire wall below the awning is an open, unmarked panel.
A front-facing person has a circular head, rounded shoulders, and a torso narrowing toward the bottom. Two small trapezoidal shopping bags with loop handles hang beside the figure, one on each side.
A broad rectangular shopping bag has softly rounded corners and a centred arched handle. The uppercase words DUTY FREE fill the front in two stacked lines beneath the handle.
A shopping bag hangs by two sloping straps from the centre of a long horizontal rounded rail. Its body has a curved bottom and a horizontal band near the base.
A front-facing woman has a circular head above a V-neck garment that narrows toward the bottom. Her arms reach toward two small handled shopping bags, with one hanging at either side.
A shopping basket has a wide rounded rim, a tapered body, and a tall handle with sloping sides and a flat top. A single short vertical slot marks the centre of the basket.
A shopping basket has a wide rounded rim, gently tapering sides, and a flat bottom with rounded corners. A broad domed handle rises above the rim, while the basket front remains blank.
A tapered shopping basket has rounded lower corners and two handles leaning inward above its rim. Two small eyes and a curved smile form a face on the front of the basket.

A side-view shopping cart has a handle projecting left from a tall upright and a basket with a rounded lower-right corner. A lower rail runs beneath the basket and supports two small loop-shaped wheels.

A side-view shopping cart has a tapered basket, a right-side handle, and two wheels joined by a lower rail. Several packages project above the basket rim, including a tall tilted item and a triangular-topped package.
A side-view shopping cart has a tapered basket and a tall handle rising at the right with a short horizontal grip. A low horizontal support joins two circular wheels beneath the basket.
A side-view shopping cart has a broad tapered basket with softly rounded corners and two large separate circular wheels below. A short angled grip rises from the upper-right edge of the basket.

A front-facing store building has paired entrance doors beneath a wide overhanging roof band. A central semicircular roof feature rises above the band and supports a short pole with a rectangular flag.
The uppercase words HOT PRICE are arranged in two lines, with HOT centred above PRICE. A pointed flame with an inward notch replaces the O in the upper word.
